Record Class GAConfig

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.ga.GAConfig
Record Components:
populationSize - number of individuals; must be positive
maxGenerations - generation limit; must be non-negative
crossoverRate - probability of applying crossover, in [0,1]
mutationRate - probability of invoking the mutation operator for each offspring, in [0,1]; gene-level operators may interpret it as a per-gene rate
progressEveryGens - progress interval, or zero to disable progress posts
refreshEveryGens - refresh interval, or zero to disable refresh requests
randomSeed - deterministic seed, or zero for a nondeterministic seed
public record GAConfig(int populationSize, int maxGenerations, double crossoverRate, double mutationRate, long progressEveryGens, long refreshEveryGens, long randomSeed) extends Record
A record to hold the configuration parameters for a genetic algorithm. This includes population size, number of generations, crossover and mutation rates, and notification intervals. The GA will use these parameters to control the evolution process.
